address: Çarşı, Cumhuriyet Caddesi No:102, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: With its red-and-white check tablecloths, photographs and paintings from Italy, vintage decor and a terrace overlooking the pebble beach, this trattoria is the embodiment of Mediterranean charm. The menu features an extensive range of tempting traditional dishes. The Neapolitan-style pizzas and creamy risotto with super-fresh seafood are especially popular. There are also 12 different dishes with house-made pasta to choose from. This generosity is just one example of why Arka has been a Bodrum favourite for so long – and rightfully so!
